senses.gloss: (transpos. of כִּסְכֵּס; cmp. גִּעְגֵּעַ; v. כָּסַס) to chew, nibble; (of fire, cmp. לָחַךְ) to graze, singe, make brittle.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 21a:4">Sabb. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>האור מְסַכְסֶכֶת בהן</he> the flame nibbles at them (producing sputtering sparks).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 6a:1">B. Kam. 6ᵃ</cite> top <he>סִכְסְכָה אבניו</he> the lapping fire attacked his neighbor’s stones; (Y. ib. II, 5ᶜ top <he>סיפספה</he>). Tosef. ib. VI, 23 <he>אם היתה מְסַכְסֶכֶת והולכת</he> if the fire went on lapping, opp. <he>קפצה</he> it skipped.
<cite ref="Chagigah 15b:5">Ḥag. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>ירדה אש וסכסכה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>סבבה</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) fire came down and lapped Rabbi’s chair.
